original_question: Mark is a copy-editor. He edits an equal number of sentences each week for two different publishers, who each pay him a different rate per sentence. Publisher B pays Mark twice what Publisher A pays. Mark edits a total number of 1000 sentences each week, and Publisher A pays him 5 cents per sentence. How much does Mark make in a week, in cents?
question_template: {name_male, Mark} is a copy-editor. He edits an equal number of sentences each week for two different publishers, who each pay him a different rate per sentence. Publisher B pays {name_male, Mark} {num_text_2, twice} what Publisher A pays. {name_male, Mark} edits a total number of {num_digit_1, 1000} sentences each week, and Publisher A pays him {num_digit_2, 5} cents per sentence. How much does {name_male, Mark} make in a week, in cents?
question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1/2) * num_digit_2 * (1 + f2)   # f2 is the numeric value of num_text_2
